summary: Frontend-only Expo/React Native TTRPG character sheet app tested end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844) via the preview URL. All 16 requested feature flows verified: empty state, FAB creation & navigation, name/class/level inputs with autosave, HP tracker (heart tap at index N -> HP=N when filled, HP=N+1 when empty), HP max editing, Armour/Melee DMG inputs, main stat and sub-skill dice rolls with animated result and verdict coloring (green/red/gold logic verified), close button dismissing modal, editable numeric stat values, Once Per Turn/Rest and Hero Ability multi-line inputs, Hero Points +/- with 0-10 clamp (confirmed capped at 10 after 15 clicks), Backstory/Inventory/Notes inputs, back navigation returning to list with correct name shown, reopening character loads all persisted data via AsyncStorage.
critical_code_review_comments: Long-press delete on character row uses Alert.alert which works on native but on web Expo builds Alert renders as a browser confirm; behavior is correct but couldn't validate via Playwright confirm dialog in this run. Consider swapping to a custom Modal for cross-platform parity.
character/[id].tsx is ~470 lines; still manageable but approaching the split threshold if more features are added.
DiceRollModal uses Math.random for tickValue with the same setTickValue dependency - no memory leak but interval cleanup is properly handled.
seed_data_creation: Created one character 'Aragorn' (Ranger, Lvl 5) with populated fields via UI; persisted through AsyncStorage across navigation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://campaign-companion-13.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844. All testIDs work as documented. AsyncStorage key is aob:characters:v1. To test long-press delete on web, override page.on('dialog') to accept the confirm dialog.
